authentication_notes: /auth/login establishes session state required for all authenticated endpoints; /auth/logout terminates it.
Operations marked auth_required need an authenticated session during test setup.
dependencies: POST /auth/login is prerequisite for any operation requiring authentication.
POST /users/register-citizen creates citizen accounts needed for POST /reports/upload.
POST /users/register-user and related admin endpoints require prior login and create users needed for role management and report assignment.
POST /reports/upload creates reports that are prerequisites for status updates, assignments, and comments.
POST /auth/login -> DELETE /auth/logout: Logout requires an active session established by login.
POST /auth/login -> GET /auth/current: Current user retrieval requires authentication.
POST /users/register-citizen -> POST /reports/upload: Citizens must register before uploading reports.
POST /users/register-user -> PATCH /users/edit-user: User editing requires the user to exist.
POST /users/register-user -> GET /users/get-roles/{userId}: Role retrieval requires the user to exist.
POST /reports/upload -> PATCH /reports/report/{id}/status: Status update requires an existing report.
POST /reports/upload -> PATCH /reports/report/{id}/assign: Assignment requires an existing report.
POST /reports/upload -> GET /reports/{report_id}/comments: Comment listing requires an existing report.
POST /reports/upload -> POST /reports/{report_id}/comment: Comment creation requires an existing report.
POST /users/admin/create-municipality-user -> GET /reports/tos-users: Technical office staff listing depends on municipality users existing.

risks: Ambiguity in 'admin only' vs 'municipality' role distinctions for report management endpoints.
Missing explicit error codes for invalid user roles or unauthorized role assignments.
No documented rate limiting or throttling for public endpoints like /reports/upload.
